name: Kristine E. Kwong
office: Pasadena Area Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Kristine E. Kwong is the incumbent Area 5 trustee for the Pasadena Area Community College District. She is an education and employment lawyer and partner at Musick, Peeler & Garrett LLP. As board president, she signed a December 2023 resolution committing the district to a zero-carbon campus and fleet by 2030. She says she prioritizes expanding K-12 dual enrollment and in-demand classes so students can complete their programs.
